name: a comment after a blank line is a note again, not a part
why: Without the part rule the window numbers every song in one run and lists "Soundcheck" and "Concert" as loose notes (debug/mb-event-soundcheck-concert-POH.html).

name: a note-like comment after a blank line becomes a part
why: "# Scheduled: 16:00 …" opens the Stone Pony and OceanFirst setlists after a blank line; it is a note, as on the event page's own tables.
grep: the event window links its setlist

name: the numbering runs on across parts
why: Each song is numbered within its part, as on the event page's own Setlist tables.

edits.find: parts.push({ n: sec.count, part: sec.name, also: [], head, tail });
edits.replace: parts.push({ n: parts.length + 1, part: sec.name, also: [], head, tail });

name: heading rows stay while the table is sorted
why: Sorted, the parts are mixed: a heading row would open a run of songs that is not that part.

name: the card previews the first part, not the longest
why: The first part is often only the soundcheck; the card shows the concert.
